sloka: वारमुख्याः तु तत् श्रुत्वा वनम् प्रविविशुः महत् ।आश्रमस्य अविदूरे अस्मिन् यत्नम् कुर्वन्ति दर्शने ॥१-१०-७॥
transliteration: vāramukhyāḥ tu tat śrutvā vanam praviviśuḥ mahat ।āśramasya avidūre asmin yatnam kurvanti darśane ॥1-10-7॥

translations.english: Having heard this, beautiful courtesans entered the great forest and remaining at a place not far from the hermitage made efforts to steal a sight of this son of a sage (Rsyasringa), this forest dweller, this controller of the senses.
translations.hindi: तब अङ्गदेश में महाबली और प्रतापी रोमपाद नाम का एक प्रसिद्ध राजा होगा
